import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; @Component({ selector: 'app-courses', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule], template: `

Courses

{{c.icon}}

{{c.title}}

{{c.subtitle}}

{{c.students}} students {{c.lessons}} lessons
` }) export class CoursesComponent { courses = [ { icon: '☕', title: 'Java Placement Program', subtitle: 'Core Java, SQL, Aptitude', students: 450, lessons: 32 }, { icon: '🚀', title: 'Java Full Stack Development', subtitle: 'Spring Boot, Angular, AWS', students: 320, lessons: 40 }, { icon: '📱', title: 'Digital Marketing', subtitle: 'SEO, SEM, Social Media', students: 180, lessons: 20 }, ]; }
